content: {"like":["Immersive, on‑location feel in period dramas like The Wizard of Lies and Apocalypto","Detailed, authentic character portrayals (e.g., Michelle Pfeiffer as Ruth Madoff)","Strong, era‑specific visual style (1950s NYC in The Best of Everything)","Engaging, twist‑heavy plots that keep interest (The Boy 2016)","Music perfectly synced to scenes (great ending soundtrack)"],"dislike":["Dull, unengaging performances (Montgomery Clift, Shelley Winters)","Depressing, depressing plot turns","Boring, uninteresting pacing (Hell Or High Water)","Zero substance, waste of time films","Unattractive vocal/appearance traits (Jeff Bridges’ raspy voice, beard)"]}
